<span class=\"n\">1.</span> Cómo solicit: 1. How to request the deletion of your data
Con el asunto <span class=\"asunto\">Sol: With the subject Data deletion request
el <strong>correo electrónico</strong> o: the email address or the phone number you registered with or were contacted on;
si aplica, el <strong>nombre de la empre: where applicable, the name of the company that contacted you or recorded your data on the Platform;

<b>No necesita tener una cuenta.</b> Pue: You do not need to have an account. You can request deletion even if you never registered with Zyntello: it is enough that some company using our platform uploaded your data or sent you a communication from it.
Para proteger su información, podemos pe: To protect your information, we may ask you for reasonable identity verification —for example, that you write from the registered email address or confirm a detail held in the file—. We will not ask you for your password, card details, or documents that are not needed to identify you.
<span class=\"n\">2.</span> Antes de sol: 2. Before you ask: identify your situation
Zyntello es una plataforma que usan otra: Zyntello is a platform other companies use to run their operations. Whose the data is determines who the right is exercised with, so there are two distinct situations:
<strong>Usted es usuario de Zyntello</st:
You are a Zyntello user
You have or had an account, or you are a member of an account's team.
Atendemos y ejecutamos su solicitud dire: We handle and carry out your request directly.
<strong>Sus datos los cargó una empresa<:
Your data was uploaded by a company
You are a customer, employee, supplier, resident, debtor or participant of a company that uses Zyntello.
<strong>Esa empresa</strong> es la respo: That company is the controller. Zyntello only hosts and processes the data on their behalf.
Canalizamos su solicitud con esa empresa: We route your request to that company, tell you so in writing and help them handle it. The final decision is theirs.
<b>Si no sabe en qué situación está, esc: If you do not know which situation you are in, write to us anyway. With the email address or phone number you give us we can determine who is responsible for your data and tell you. No request is discarded for being addressed to the wrong party.
<span class=\"n\">3.</span> Qué ocurre t: 3. What happens after your request
<strong>Confirmación de recibo.</strong>: Acknowledgement of receipt. We reply confirming that we received the request, normally within 2 working days.
<strong>Verificación.</strong> Comprobam: Verification. We check your identity and locate your data. If we need any additional detail to identify you, we ask for it then.
<strong>Determinación del responsable.</: Identifying the controller. If your data was uploaded by a Subscriber company, we contact them and tell you who the request was routed to.
<strong>Ejecución.</strong> Eliminamos o: Execution. We delete or block the data as appropriate.
<strong>Respuesta final por escrito.</st: Final written reply. We tell you what was deleted, what was kept and why. Maximum period: 30 days from receipt of the verified request.
<b>El servicio es gratuito.</b> No cobra: The service is free. We do not charge for handling a deletion request, nor do we require any reason for making one.
Los datos eliminados desaparecen también: Deleted data also disappears from our backups once the rotation cycle completes, which is 30 days. During that time it is blocked and is not used for any purpose.
<b>Copias descargadas por la empresa sus: Copies downloaded by the Subscriber company. The Platform lets each Subscriber company download a backup file with their own data. Once downloaded, that file is in the company's hands and beyond Zyntello's reach: we cannot locate or delete it. If your data was uploaded by a Subscriber company, deleting those copies is up to that company, and we will pass your request on to them as described above.
Según su situación y el alcance que soli: Depending on your situation and the scope you request, deletion may cover:
sus <strong>datos de cuenta y de acceso<: your account and sign-in data: name, email, phone, password, roles and permissions;
sus <strong>datos de contacto</strong> e: your contact details in the customer, supplier or business contact records;
<strong>fotografías</strong> suyas o de: photographs of you or of your property that had been uploaded;
<strong>registros de ubicación geográfic: geographic location records associated with your activity;
<strong>notas, comentarios y anotaciones: notes, comments and management annotations that mention you;
su <strong>número de teléfono</strong> d: your phone number from the messaging lists, together with the record of your opt-out request;

<b>Sobre el registro de baja.</b> Puede: About the opt-out record. It may seem contradictory to keep your phone number or email after you ask for deletion, but it is the only way to guarantee you do not receive messages again: if we erased the item entirely, a later upload could include it once more. It is kept solely for the purpose of excluding it.
<span class=\"n\">6.</span> Solo quiero: 6. I only want to stop receiving messages
Si su intención no es eliminar sus datos: If your aim is not to delete your data but to stop receiving communications, the process is simpler and faster:
<strong>WhatsApp</strong>: responda al m: WhatsApp: reply to the message asking to opt out, or block the number. If the messages come from a company that uses Zyntello, that company must stop sending them immediately. If they do not, write to us and we will take it up with them.
<strong>Correo electrónico</strong>: use: Email: use the unsubscribe link at the foot of every commercial email.
<strong>En cualquier caso</strong>: escr: In any case: write to us at info@zyntello.com with the subject Communications opt-out. We process it within a maximum of 72 hours.
<b>Los mensajes que envían las empresas: Messages sent by Subscriber companies do not originate from Zyntello. Each company is responsible for having your consent and for acting on your opt-out. We provide the tool and the mechanisms to record that preference, and we help when a request is not acted on.
La baja de comunicaciones comerciales no: Opting out of commercial communications does not stop strictly transactional messages while a relationship with that company is in force (for example, the invoice for a service you contracted).
Además de la eliminación, puede solicita: Besides deletion, you may request access to your data, its rectification, to object to processing, and —where the law provides for it— portability and restriction of processing, as well as withdrawing a consent you gave. The procedure and the deadlines are the same as described here.
El detalle de sus derechos, la normativa: The detail of your rights, the rules applicable in each country and the categories of data we process are in the Privacy Policy (sections 9 and 10).
